palette.notes: Marker on grid paper filmed by phone; code palette_size 13 is the quantised photo. The Sonic design uses blue with a darker navy for shading, peach skin, white gloves, red shoes and black outline squares.

lighting: Indoor room light on paper; the sprite has its own flat light (darker blue on the shadow side of the quills).
silhouette: Classic Sonic sprite: spiky quills, big eyes, red shoes; strong silhouette with a full black outline.

motion.timing: Code: median hold 33.3 ms, 29.77 changes/s (30 fps phone video); no frame animation, a jump-cut drawing process.

texture: Hand-filled marker squares on a printed blue grid; dots mark cells before filling.
camera: Handheld top-down; blank paper, marker thumbs-up, dot-mapping cells, jump to filled sprite, then the cut-out stuck on a wall full of other pieces.

acting.enters: Blank grid paper first, then the marker held up like a promise.
acting.acts: Dots map the shape, fills jump-cut to the finished Sonic.
acting.exits: Cut out and carried off the page.
acting.depth: Final reveal: the new piece is small among a wall of past pieces (Pokemon, Hello Kitty, etc.).

techniques: dot-map then fill (plan cells before colouring)
end on the collection wall: the new piece among many
full black outline + one darker shade per colour
feel: NOT PIXEL ART: marker-on-grid-paper craft of a pixel sprite; blank page + jump-cut fill + wall-of-pieces reveal = satisfying payoff.
for_fred: End a reel by pulling back to show Fred small among a wall or crowd of his past appearances; a cheap, strong 'there is more' payoff.
